decision: Reusable documentation patterns identified from project-specific mocks are implemented as neutral bundled Lit components that consume Grounded design tokens. The reusable set includes grounded-doc-header, grounded-section, grounded-pill-link-list, grounded-detail-list, and grounded-detail-row; project-specific analytics concepts remain data or template content rather than core components.
name: Generalize reusable documentation components
description: Documents the reusable Lit component extraction from a project-specific analytics documentation mock.
